title: Better Axe MC
description: This project remakes axes by giving them a double-sided blade, making both sides sharp. It improves their visual design while keeping the original Minecraft style and making tools look more realistic and detailed.
body: This texture pack redesigns the appearance of axes in Minecraft by turning them into double-edged tools. Each axe is now more symmetrical, with sharp blades on both sides, creating a cleaner and more balanced look. This change enhances the overall visual style while staying faithful to Minecraft’s original aesthetic, making tools feel sharper, more realistic, and more satisfying to use in-game.
